answers.answer: New git repo; lateralus becomes v1 archive only

answers.note: all the agentic behaviors go through an interceptor chain and ABSOLUTELY all state change is transmitted through an immutable context map. I want this system to be absolutely auditable and traceable.
answers.answer: Interceptor chain (proposed plan) — single extension mechanism

Core agent loop (LLM + tool dispatch + retries)
GraalVM native-image target
Fresh start — v2 uses new session format; v1 sessions abandoned
Clean-slate CLI — redesign flags from scratch, no compat guarantee

No god module — core/engine stays small (<200 LOC target)
All LLM calls through LlmClient protocol; no direct http/completion from loop
Malli validation on every external/network boundary (HTTP, embed, search)
External deps behind protocols with instrumented implementations
Sequential tool execution by default (no pmap without explicit opt-in)
Pick one extension style (protocol OR defmulti, not both ad hoc)
Single plugin/interceptor registration path — no ad-hoc add-*-tool! functions
Every namespace has tests before merge; no 500+ LOC untested modules

Replacing HTML scraping with paid search APIs
Sandboxing repl-eval (separate security initiative)
Multi-agent orchestration / intercom coordination
pi / Cursor SDK integration as first-class feature
Custom TUI beyond basic interactive CLI
Hosted/cloud deployment infrastructure
MVP bar: core loop + memory + CLI work; file tools and extras can follow
